verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents its own proxy layer for avoiding blocks: a premium_proxy option to bypass difficult sites, country_code geotargeting, and a stealth_proxy mode. The session_id parameter, which pins multiple requests to the same IP, implies requests otherwise vary across a pool of IPs, but rotation itself is never stated outright. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of IP rotation and pool behavior, details on pool size or IP types, and independent or hands-on corroboration that rotation avoids blocks.

support.subject: As a developer, I can route requests through a rotating pool of proxy IPs to avoid blocks

citations.quote: premium_proxy [boolean] (false) Use premium proxies to bypass difficult to scrape websites
session_id [integer] ("") Route multiple API requests through the same IP address
Use `country_code` with `premium_proxy=true` to target a country for premium proxy geolocation.
